notes: The weblog list (ul.list-news) starts with a 'Featured' post from Oct. 19, 2026, then Nov. 3 and Oct. 26, then Oct. 8 and older. By date the three most recent are Nov. 3, Oct. 26 and Oct. 19, which are also the first three entries on the page, so both readings give the same set; the capture holds exactly these three post pages. One item per post, keyed by the post page's h1 (the only h1, in #main-content), listed in weblog page order. The expected selection on each post is that h1 plus the full article body; the byline ('Posted by ... on ...') is excluded. Ambiguity: page order is not date order because of the featured post; a run that orders by date still matches, since grading is by key. Each item's include lists section headings, list entries and a sentence from the start and the end of the article body (the leave post has no headings, so body sentences only); its exclude lists the 'Posted by ... on ...' byline, the 'Back to Top' link, a sidebar heading and the footer's 'Django Links' heading, which must not appear in that post's content.
